world.title: How Buddhist Maldives became an Islamic sultanate exactly 900 years ago
world.summary: The Maldives is commemorating 900 Hijri years since its last Buddhist king converted to Islam, establishing an Islamic sultanate. Historical evidence, including ancient ruins and copper plates, highlights a narrative involving sea-demon legends, Arabian trade, the destruction of Buddhist monasteries, and the construction of a mosque over one. Additionally, it notes the beheading of monks in the capital, Male.

world.title: 'Vessel attacked by Iran twice': US rejects IRGC claim that Panama-flagged tanker hit naval mine in Hormuz
world.summary: The US military dismissed Iran's Revolutionary Guard claim that a Panama-flagged tanker hit a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz. The vessel was reportedly attacked twice, with the US Central Command stating there was no evidence supporting the mine collision assertion. The incident highlights ongoing tensions in the region and differing narratives regarding maritime security.

world.title: U.S. Judge blocks Trump limits on duration of visas for foreign students, journalists
world.summary: A federal judge has blocked a Trump administration rule that would limit the duration of visas for foreign students and journalists. The judge cited insufficient justification from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) for the proposed changes. This ruling allows affected individuals to maintain their current visa durations without the need for immediate extensions.

business.title: Stocks in news: Tata Group stocks, HDFC Bank, Coforge, HFCL, Sun Pharma and Varun Beverages
business.summary: On September 11, Indian stock markets rebounded after an initial dip, with key index heavyweights attracting selective buying that mitigated overall losses. Major companies, including HDFC Bank, remained in focus due to relevant corporate announcements. Additionally, SEBI's discussion paper on the Closing Auction Session received input on five critical areas, highlighting ongoing regulatory considerations in the market.

business.title: Analysts remain bullish on L&T, see up to 16% upside on order book strength
business.summary: Analysts are optimistic about Larsen & Toubro's future growth despite share volatility. A record order book and strong capital expenditure demand support this outlook. Recent geopolitical issues affected execution, but no major projects were cancelled. The company anticipates improved momentum and order inflows in the second half of FY27, alongside strategic divestments and investments in new growth areas.

business.title: Retail inflation surges to 8-month high of 4.8% in August
business.summary: Retail inflation in India reached an eight-month high of 4.8% in August, up from 4.5% in July, according to National Statistics Office data. The increase was primarily attributed to rising food prices. This marks a significant change in the consumer price index (CPI) trend, reflecting ongoing economic pressures and potential implications for monetary policy and consumer spending.

technology.title: High-end iQOO tablet leaks with 16GB RAM and next-gen Snapdragon chipset
technology.summary: The iQOO Pad Ultra, identified by model number "iPA2691," has been spotted on Geekbench, indicating its imminent launch. This compact gaming tablet is expected to feature Qualcomm’s next-generation Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset and 16GB of RAM. The model previously appeared in China’s SRRC database, confirming its association with the upcoming iQOO device.

technology.title: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma May Have Personally Responded to Your Customer Support Ticket
technology.summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has been active in her first six months, ending the "This is Xbox" marketing campaign and reducing Xbox Game Pass Ultimate's subscription price. She has also managed layoffs and studio changes. Additionally, Sharma has engaged directly with customers by responding to support tickets, aiming to better understand Xbox's products and customer needs.

technology.title: Dolphine Villa / Idee architects
technology.summary: Dolphin Villa, designed by Idee architects, is set to be completed in 2026 in Hanoi, Vietnam. The project spans an area of 1,000 m² and aims to enhance the connection between domestic life and the surrounding environment. The villa is part of a newly developed urban area, with images captured by photographer Trieu Chien.

sports.title: Asia Cup trophy row: BCCI's Rajeev Shukla says Naqvi did not raise any objection on ‘collective decision’
sports.summary: BCCI Vice-President Rajeev Shukla stated that the Indian women's cricket team's refusal to accept the Asia Cup trophy from Mohsin Naqvi was a "collective decision" made by the Board. He emphasized that Naqvi did not raise any objections regarding this decision. The statement was made on September 14, 2026, amidst discussions about the trophy presentation.

sports.title: Varun Chakaravarthy out of Afghanistan T20Is with side strain, set to leave for CoE
sports.summary: Varun Chakaravarthy has been ruled out of the T20I series against Afghanistan due to a side strain. The 35-year-old spinner recently returned from a two-month rehabilitation at the Centre of Excellence in Bengaluru. His availability for the upcoming Asian Games will be determined after further assessment of his scans conducted in Bengaluru.

sports.title: Yamal Says Messi, Cristiano Were Historic, but He Achieved More as a ‘Young’ Player
sports.summary: Barcelona forward Lamine Yamal, at 19, has highlighted his achievements, comparing them to those of football legends Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo. He acknowledges their historic contributions but emphasizes that he has accomplished more at a younger age. Yamal expresses a desire to continue improving and achieving further success in his career, indicating his ambitions for the future.

health.title: Iron Deficiency Symptoms & Health Tips
health.summary: Iron deficiency can cause symptoms like fatigue, weakness, dizziness, headaches, and hair loss. It is particularly common among women with heavy periods, pregnant women, children, and those with inadequate diets. Iron is essential for producing hemoglobin, which transports oxygen and supports energy levels. Addressing iron deficiency can help alleviate these symptoms and improve overall health.

health.title: UVA School of Data Science emphasizes responsible AI use amid growing concerns
health.summary: The University of Virginia's School of Data Science is highlighting the importance of responsible AI usage amid increasing concerns about its rapid development. Prominent tech figures, such as Dario Amodei of Claude AI and Sam Altman of OpenAI, have advocated for a slowdown in AI model development to address potential risks and ethical implications associated with advanced artificial intelligence technologies.

health.title: Obesity could weaken a natural defense against breast cancer
health.summary: Obesity is associated with an increased risk of breast cancer and more aggressive forms of the disease. Recent research indicates that lean breast fat releases a molecule that aids in killing breast cancer cells, while obesity diminishes this protective mechanism. The biological connection between obesity and breast cancer remains unclear, highlighting the need for further investigation into this relationship.

science.title: Magma repeatedly breaks and heals during eruptions, microscopic evidence suggests
science.summary: Microscopic evidence indicates that magma undergoes repeated breaking and healing during volcanic eruptions. This process contributes to the formation of pyroclasts, which are fragments of magma and rock ejected during explosive eruptions. Understanding the size and formation of these particles is crucial, as they significantly impact their travel distance and associated hazards, exemplified by the recent eruption of Mount Etna.

science.title: Hierarchical Clustering Satisfies Kleinberg's Three Axioms
science.summary: A new proof demonstrates that hierarchical clustering satisfies all three of Kleinberg's axioms simultaneously, challenging a 20-year-old impossibility theorem. This theorem previously asserted that no clustering method could be scale invariant, rich, and consistent concurrently. The findings suggest that the limitations can be overcome by utilizing a hierarchical output, thereby reshaping the evaluation of clustering methods.

science.title: Unused natural gas behind NYC's $300 million waste of a potent greenhouse gas
science.summary: A new study from the Lamont-Doherty Earth Observatory reveals that methane emissions in the New York City metropolitan area are primarily caused by natural gas usage. Published in Atmospheric Chemistry and Physics, the research suggests that cities could reduce methane emissions significantly while also saving consumers millions of dollars associated with wasted natural gas.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: September 15, 2026
entertainment.summary: Horoscope for September 15, 2026, encourages individuals, particularly Pisces, to recognize their freedom and not feel trapped. It suggests that focusing too much on obstacles may prevent progress. The message emphasizes the importance of taking action rather than waiting for perfect timing. Overall, the horoscope aims to inspire confidence and a proactive approach to personal challenges.

entertainment.title: Taylor Swift skips the Emmys after losing her nomination? Here’s where she may be instead
entertainment.summary: Taylor Swift's The Eras Tour: The Final Show received five Emmy nominations but lost Outstanding Variety Special, Pre-Recorded to The Muppet Show at the Creative Arts Emmys. Since her category will not be televised at the September 14 Primetime Emmys, her attendance is unlikely. Additionally, Travis Kelce's NFL season opener may provide Swift with another commitment elsewhere.

entertainment.title: Sagittarius Horoscope Today: September 15, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 15, 2026, Sagittarius individuals are encouraged to reflect and gain new perspectives. Engaging in physical activity, such as walking, can help rejuvenate their mindset. The day is favorable for receiving insights and ideas related to their current life situations and ongoing questions. Embracing change and fresh experiences is advised to enhance their overall well-being.
